description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Creates a flayr account for an AI agent, no key or browser needed: sends a 6-digit code to `email` (an inbox you read, e.g. AgentMail). Calling it accepts the flayr Terms of Service and Privacy Policy for the account. Every agent account starts on the Free plan. If the address already has a flayr account, the same call is how an agent logs in: agent_signup_verify then returns a capped key on that account.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/agent-signup.)

email.description: The agent's own inbox; the code is sent here.

intendedUse.description: What the agent will use flayr for.

ownerEmail.description: The human who answers for the agent (may be required by flayr's abuse settings).

name: agent_signup
title: Create a flayr account (agent)
